answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the canyon forfeiture shows up in the lotus totals with the atlas audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 11% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 139 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
